propositions: The reconciler requires a backend selection mechanism (config key + registry + entry point) that is currently missing.
Backend vendor selection is implicit in module imports; the selection infrastructure must make it config-driven via reconciler.backend field with _as_choice validation.
select_backend(config) must resolve the configured backend key from an in-tree decorator registry and return a Backend instance without rewiring existing consumers.
JiraBackend must be registered in the module-level registry via @register decorator side-effect triggered by importing adapters package.
Config-load static validation via _as_choice(v, k, {"jira"}) must guard against unknown backend keys independent of runtime registry.
The registry import must be lazy inside select_backend() to avoid circular imports and ensure adapters are loaded before lookup.
